name: Mobix App Builder
author: BurgerThemes

sections.description:
Mobix App Builder is a dynamic plugin that seamlessly converts your WordPress website into a stunning mobile app. Boost user engagement, expand your reach, and deliver a fast, app-like experience—no coding skills required!

External services

This plugin connects to the Mobix WP Builder external service in order to synchronize WooCommerce product categories and app data needed to build and maintain the mobile app.

When using this plugin, the following data may be sent to the external service:

  • WooCommerce category data – including category ID, name, slug, description, parent category, and (if available) category image URL.
  • Store code / promo code – entered by the site owner in the plugin settings.
  • Event type – such as category_created_or_updated or category_deleted.
  • Technical metadata – including request timestamp and source (“WooCommerce”).

This data is transmitted only when categories are created, updated, or deleted in WooCommerce, or when the plugin explicitly synchronizes with the Mobix WP Builder service.
No personal customer or order data is transmitted.

Service provider:
Mobix WP Builder
https://mobixwp.com/

Terms of Service: https://mobixwp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mobixwp.com/privacy/policy

Features

  • WooCommerce Integration
  • Live Content Sync
  • Push Notifications
  • Custom Design
  • Multi-language Support
  • And many more
